title.zh-CN: Comrades 2027 资格标准：不同距离资格赛事的完赛时限上限
title.en: Comrades 2027 qualifying standards: finish-time ceiling by qualifying race distance

unit.zh-CN: 完赛时限（分钟，达到或快于该标准方可申请）
unit.en: finish-time ceiling in minutes (qualifying result must be at or faster)

note.zh-CN: 时限照录 CMA 官方 FAQ 资格表（42.2 km 4:59:59、48 km 5:59:59、50 km 6:09:59、52–54 km 6:29:59、56 km 6:59:59、60 km 7:39:59、64 km 8:14:59、80 km 10:34:59、90 km 11:59:59、100 km 13:34:59），图内按分钟取整显示；只认官方公布成绩，Garmin/Strava 个人设备记录不接受。本站自制图，非官方赛道剖面。
note.en: Ceilings transcribed from the official CMA FAQ qualification table (42.2 km 4:59:59, 48 km 5:59:59, 50 km 6:09:59, 52–54 km 6:29:59, 56 km 6:59:59, 60 km 7:39:59, 64 km 8:14:59, 80 km 10:34:59, 90 km 11:59:59, 100 km 13:34:59); chart rounds to minutes. Only officially published results count; Garmin/Strava personal-device records are not accepted. Site-made chart, not an official course profile.

title.zh-CN: 2026 Comrades（Up Run）：起跑人数与完赛人数

note.zh-CN: 起跑 21,633 人取自 CMA 赛前医疗安全博客；完赛 18,523 人取自 CMA 2026 赛后官方博客；两者分别来自不同官方发布，未含退赛与关门细节。本站自制图，非官方赛道剖面。
note.en: Starters 21,633 from the CMA pre-race medical-safety blog; finishers 18,523 from the CMA official 2026 post-race blog; the two figures come from separate official releases and do not break down retirements or cut-offs. Site-made chart, not an official course profile.
